answer: Each identity must lock a bond that unlocks only after ten epochs of peer-graded output. Grading pairs are drawn at random from the staked pool, so a fake cluster mostly grades itself and every vote it casts is discounted by a shared-neighbour penalty. Slashing one bond also burns the weight of every attestation it countersigned — an echo of the fraud travelling with it. The attacker pays a fresh bond per head while each clone's earning power decays toward zero; only steady honest work climbs to the zenith, where a quill earns nothing unless its ink is paid for.
